# IBKR WebAPI | Trading Web API

The [/bond-filters endpoint](/docs/campus/ibkr-api-page/cpapi-v1#search-bond-filters) has been added to documentation, which is used to retrieve relevant bond information such as maturity dates, issue dates, coupon, and currency.
